reviewer: assistant visual inspection of saved native-rendered contact sheet

observations.text: Fine dark cracks, short horizontal gaps, and patch boundary discontinuities remain visible after 400 steps. Coverage increases locally and color changes slightly; the road is not visually seamless.

A central black road-render footprint is present before and after fitting. The contact sheet alone does not assign this footprint to retained-object K or missing surface support; use the separately exported masks and contribution layers.
A bright vehicle-shaped residual with a dark trailing region remains visible before and after fitting. Layer attribution belongs to the independent contribution-layer audit.

The same families of dark horizontal cracks and fragmented boundaries remain visible. Original appearance_C/S masks are empty for these frames, so this review does not report an empty-domain alpha success.

verdict: Fixed 400-step seam fit completed and improved the measured coverage; visible seams and residual scene structure remain. This is not a visual-quality success verdict.
